name: math
judge_criteria: Compare the final numeric answer with the reference. Strip whitespace, units, and trailing zeros. Score 1.0 for exact match, 0.0 otherwise.

samples.input: A store sells notebooks for $3 each and pens for $1.50 each. Maria buys 4 notebooks and 6 pens. She pays with a $50 bill. How much change does she receive?
A train travels at 60 mph for 2.5 hours, then at 80 mph for 1.5 hours. What is the total distance traveled in miles?
A rectangular garden is 12 meters long and 8 meters wide. A path 1 meter wide is built around the outside of the garden. What is the area of the path in square meters?
Emma earns $15 per hour. She works 8 hours on Monday, 6 hours on Tuesday, and 10 hours on Wednesday. She spends 40% of her earnings on rent. How many dollars does she have left after paying rent?

A tank is being filled by two pipes. Pipe A can fill the tank in 6 hours. Pipe B can fill it in 4 hours. If both pipes are opened simultaneously, how many hours will it take to fill the tank? Give your answer as a decimal.
A baker uses 3/4 cup of sugar for each batch of cookies. She wants to make 5 batches but only has 3 cups of sugar. How many more cups of sugar does she need? Give your answer as a fraction.
A car depreciates by 15% each year. If the car costs $20,000 new, what is its value after 3 years? Round to the nearest dollar.
In a class of 40 students, 25 play soccer, 20 play basketball, and 10 play both. How many students play neither soccer nor basketball?
A sequence starts with 2, 6, 18, 54, ... What is the 8th term in this sequence?
A cylindrical water tank has a radius of 3 meters and a height of 7 meters. How many cubic meters of water can it hold? Use pi = 3.14159 and round to the nearest integer.
Three consecutive even numbers sum to 78. What is the largest of the three numbers?
A company has 120 employees. 45% are female. The company hires 30 more employees, all male. What percentage of the total workforce is now female? Round to the nearest integer.
An investment of $5,000 earns 8% annual compound interest. What is the total amount after 5 years? Round to the nearest cent.
A right triangle has legs of length 5 and 12. What is the length of the hypotenuse?
A palindromic number reads the same forwards and backwards. How many 3-digit palindromic numbers are there?
